<function name="SetSortOrigin" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the sort origin for given particle system. This is used as a helper to determine which particles are in front of which.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="origin" type="Vector">The new sort origin.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
